observations: Photo 0 shows a Nikon Z fc camera body with body cap attached; 'Nikon' and 'Z fc' lettering visible on top plate.
Photo 1 shows the top shutter-speed dial and a mounted manual-focus lens with aperture and distance rings; 'Nikon' and 'Z fc' visible.
Photo 2 shows the full kit laid out: camera body, Nikon EN-EL25a battery, Nikon MH-32 charger, body cap, rear lens cap, and a small cap marked 'TTArtisan'; mounted lens appears to be a manual prime.
All three photos carry a watermark reading 'OYIBEST GLOBAL RESOURCES'.

claims.claim: Nikon Z fc retro-inspired SLR-style mirrorless camera
claims.evidence: photo 0, photo 1, photo 2 show Nikon Z fc branding and retro dial layout
photos show the camera body but cannot confirm sensor resolution

risks.risk: Sensor may have dust, fungus, or scratches
risks.proof: Photo of sensor with lens removed and light shone on it
risks.if_unproven: priced as sensor damaged or dirty

risks.risk: Battery and charger may be non-genuine or degraded
risks.proof: Close-up photos of battery and charger labels showing Nikon branding and model numbers

risks.proof: Photo of screen powered on showing full display

risks.risk: Top dials and buttons may be sticky or non-functional
